bio: The Hegmanns run this genuinely charming restaurant that is a hit with diners. Only the best produce makes its way into the dishes, which are meticulously prepared to bring out the full flavour of the ingredients. You can opt for a set menu or order à la carte. On Thursdays, only tapas are served. Excellent wine list. Extremely friendly waitstaff. Tip: the chef's table is very close to the kitchen, but sheltered from the thick of the action....
